statement: Every producer whose answer a consumer tests with typeof x.then === 'function' returns a promise unconditionally (the raft operation port's propose calls among them), the 26 consumer-side checks are deleted, and the pattern becomes an ESLint no-restricted-syntax selector so a value-or-promise return cannot reappear; src/raft/raft-rs-runtime-owner.js with nine sites is the first producer.

constraints.statement: A check is deleted only when its producer's return has one shape. Wrapping the consumer side in Promise.resolve keeps the ambiguity and is not a fix.
A producer that answered synchronously on some path and now answers asynchronously names in the attempt every consumer whose ordering assumption changed and the witness that covers it.
The selector lands with the last deletion, never earlier.
The src/ changes land only behind an approving verification newer than the last attempt.
